name: Berggasthof Kölnberg
beschreibung: Berggasthof Kölnberg is located in the municipality of Ebbs in Tyrol. The inn enjoys a tranquil setting with panoramic views of the rugged Kaisergebirge mountains. The accommodation features simple rooms styled with authentic Tyrolean decor. The restaurant serves traditional dishes of Austrian cuisine. The inn serves as a great starting point for hiking adventures in the Kaisergebirge. During the winter season, skiers can take advantage of nearby ski resorts. High quality regional cooking takes center stage.
